reviewer: active implementation agent; distinct from coding agent, not independent human review

checks: Whole-spec validation precedes wrapper handling. Portable guards precede property access.
The function delegates each observation to the existing checker and retains exact results.
Own-property comparisons preserve unknowns and distinguish object and array equality.
Fail precedes unknown; all steps and adjacent state links remain in order.
Only fresh result data is returned; source, observations, and options are unchanged.
No target execution, file I/O, network, package changes, or added dependencies occur.

limits: No prose-only control or coding-efficiency comparison.
Five rules in the frozen model remain opaque; the typed adapter checks return unknown.
Observation continuity does not prove runtime execution order or source conformance.
Validation is repeated by checkOperation for each step; no performance improvement is claimed.
